description: The looks an illustrated story can be drawn in. Shows the person a picker with a sample picture of each look (where their chat shows cards). Free. Also list them yourself (name and one line each), for chats that don't show it: vintage (Vintage editorial illustration: Warm paper, textured illustration, elegant serif type, slow cinematic movement.); handdrawn (Hand-drawn storytelling: Illustrated environments, simple characters, sketch details, gentle animation.); collage (Cinematic collage: Layered images, masking, paper and photographic textures, depth and parallax.); anime (Anime-style originals: Cel-shaded original characters, soft painted skies, cinematic framing.); noir (Ink noir: High-contrast black ink, deep shadows, one red accent.); papercut (Paper cut-out: Layered cut paper, soft shadows, handmade depth.); lamplit (Lamplit oil: Moody period scenes in oil paint, lit by one warm light.); baroque (Baroque oil: Dark cinematic oil painting: dramatic light out of deep shadow, gold highlights, epic scale.).
